sections.overview: This small sciaenid ranges along the western Atlantic coast from Venezuela to southern Brazil.
sections.identification: It is a small croaker of the genus Stellifer, recorded to about 21 cm total length.
sections.habitat: It is demersal in shallow estuaries and nearby coastal waters, over muddy or sandy-mud bottoms.
sections.diet: A study of three Stellifer species in a Brazilian bay found that all fed mainly on crustaceans.
sections.behavior: In a comparative study, it was caught in shallow waters of Caraguatatuba Bay.
sections.reproduction: In one southern Brazilian estuary, reproduction was concentrated in spring and summer, with batches of eggs released over the season.
sections.ecology: It contributes to estuarine fish communities but is also caught incidentally in shrimp trawls.
sections.conservation: The cited 2020 assessment classified it as Data Deficient; this is not a finding that the species is safe from threats.
